Opposite Party :- State Of U.P. Thru. Prin. Secy. Deptt. Of Home Lko. And 3 Others

Counsel for Opposite Party :- G.A.
Hon'ble Pankaj Bhatia,J.
1.
Heard learned counsel for the applicant, learned AGA and perused the record.
No one appears for the opposite party no.2 despite notice.
2. The accused-applicant seeks bail in Case Crime No.99 of 2023 under sections 354, 376, 504, 506 IPC and section 7/8, 3/4 POCSO Act, P.S. Mall, District Lucknow.
3. In terms of the FIR, it was alleged that the applicant was committed wrong on the daughter of the informant over a span of one year.
In the statement under section 161 Cr.P.C., the victim stated that she was being harassed by the applicant for the last one year and had also given a telephone to her.

sentences.text: It was also stated that around one month ago, the applicant had committed wrong on her.
In the statement under section 164 Cr.P.C., she made a specific allegations that she was being harassed by the applicant for the last two years and on 23.03.2023, wrong was committed on her.
She also disclosed this fact to the family of the applicant on 29.03.2023, which resulted in an altercation and FIR was lodged on 07.04.2023 and the medical of the victim was done on 08.04.2023.
The medical on record suggests that according to the examination, finding sexual activity has been performed.
4. In the light of the said medical report, the submission of the counsel for the applicant is that even as per the version under section 161 Cr.P.C., physical relations were formed on 23.03.2023.
and there is no averment or material to justify the lodging of the FIR after about fourteen days of the alleged incident.
He argues that medical on record was conducted on 08.04.2023, which in all probably cannot be co-related to the alleged offence committed on 23.03.2023.
The tentative age of the victim as per the medical is around seventeen years.

5. Considering the inordinate delay in lodging of the FIR and the medical prima-facie not being able to co-relate with the offence committed around fourteen days ago, a case for bail is made out particularly when the applicant has no criminal history and is in jail since 08.04.2023.
Thus, the bail application is allowed.

6. Let the applicant Chandra Prakash be released on bail in aforesaid first information report number subject to his furnishing a personal bond and two reliable sureties of Rs.20,000/- (Twenty Thousand) each of the like amount to the satisfaction of the court concerned with the following conditions:
(a) The applicant shall execute a bond to undertake to attend the hearings;
(b) The applicant shall not commit any offence similar to the offence of which he is accused or suspected of the commission; and (c) The applicant shall not directly or indirectly make any inducement, threat or promise to any person acquainted with the facts of the case so as to dissuade him from disclosing such facts to the Court or to any police officer or tamper with the evidence.
Order Date :- 16.2.2024 VNP/-
